questions.question: The length of the latus rectum of the parabola $y^{2}=12x$ is (a) 3  (b) 6  (c) 12  (d) 4
questions.solution:
Compare $y^{2}=12x$ with the standard form $y^{2}=4ax$:
$$4a=12 \implies a=3$$
The length of the latus rectum is $4a$, so
$$4a=4(3)=12$$

**Correct option: (c) 12**
questions.knowledgeNote: For $y^{2}=4ax$ the latus rectum has length $4a$ and passes through the focus $(a,0)$.
